content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-160. - Violations not exclusive.

faqs.a:
The provisions of this division imposing limitations, restrictions, and prohibitions
               on parking shall not relieve any person from the duty to observe other more restrictive
               provisions limiting, restricting, or prohibiting the stopping, standing, or parking
               of a vehicle in a specified place, at a specified time, or in a specified manner.
               If a driver or registered owner is issued a civil parking citation and summons and
               complaint at the same time, the citation and summons may be written into different
               jurisdictions.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
